points.description: States that muscles move bones (i.e. produce movement of the skeleton/body by pulling on bones). Equivalent wording such as 'help the body move by pulling on bones' or 'cause bones to move at joints' is acceptable. Answers saying only 'to help us stay strong' or 'to give shape' without movement do not earn the mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark for stating that muscles move bones or produce body movement via bones. No mark for answers that omit movement or give unrelated functions only (e.g. protection, shape).
